captions.title: Open the invite link
captions.line: It shows who invited you. You join their team.

captions.title: About you
captions.line: Your full name and the email you check.

captions.title: Your phone and your state
captions.line: The state is where you mostly work.

captions.title: Choose a password
captions.line: Eight letters or more. Then tap Next.

captions.title: Where your money goes
captions.line: Pick your bank, then type your ten digit account number.

captions.title: The name comes from your bank
captions.line: If it is not your name, check the number again.

captions.title: Three things, then you are in
captions.line: Free to join, real deals only, paid every month.

captions.title: Create my account
captions.line: One tap, and you are signed in straight away.

captions.title: This is your home screen
captions.line: Your own invite code is here, ready to share.
